create_CCT_model: create a CCT video classification model using cct_14 with custom image size and number of frames
build_CCT_tokenizer: build a 3D CNN tokenizer that convolves video tensors and flattens spatial-temporal dimensions
create_TransformerClassifier: create a Transformer classifier with sequence pooling and sinusoidal positional embeddings
create_Attention_module: create a multi-head attention module with qkv projections and dropout
test_Tokenizer_sequence_length: test the Tokenizer to compute output sequence length for given video dimensions
